title: Oddomorphisms, Split-Off Minors, and the Strong Roberson Conjecture
summary: We show that the existence of an oddomorphism from a graph $F$ to a graph $G$ does not imply that $G$ is a minor of $F$. This answers a question posed by Roberson (2022) and shows that the CFI graphs cannot be used to prove the Strong Roberson Conjecture. Additionally, we introduce the concept of a split-off minor and show that the existence of an oddomorphism from $F$ to $G$ implies that $G$ is a split-off minor of $F$.
